label: Milan Cathedral crossing model

value.text: Tiburio sketches on a Codex Atlanticus sheet

claims.statement: An Ambrosiana caption retrieved with f. 812 recto mentions 'architectural sketches for the tiburio of the Duomo' with centerings, compound beams and grotesque profiles; the caption may belong to a neighbouring sheet.

sources.cite: Veneranda Biblioteca Ambrosiana, catalogue page, Codex Atlanticus f. 812 recto, automated cart. Read through search engine excerpts in this session; the page itself was not fetched in this session.

open_questions: The payments for the model (1487 to 1490) need their archival reference: Annali della Fabbrica del Duomo, volume and page to locate (Villata 1999 or Beltrami 1919).
Which Codex Atlanticus and Ms B folios carry tiburio designs? Not located in this session.
